Darknesses

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Darknesses

The darkness behind the moon is the indirect source of kobolds. The darkness behind the stars is the source of the meteors that Lord Ward watches for (see 22.10 for more).

Dwarven

The dwarves know there are many darknesses. There is the Clinging Dark, the muffling and oppressive darkness that closes in on the lonely and the lost. There is the Dreaming Dark that turns up strange flashes and patterns that quicken the imagination. There is the Gigantic Dark, which echoes and expands, leaving the mind reeling from the vastness of creation.

Connections

*The Haunting Dark was summoned to Station Seven (16.01) by the curse of a dying dwarf, and it cannot be satiated. Category:Phenomena Category:Deities
